command:
BUFFER_OWNERSHIP_TESTS=$("$1" snapshot::validation::owned_unsigned_matrix::tests:: --list)
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$BUFFER_OWNERSHIP_TESTS" | awk '/^snapshot::validation::owned_unsigned_matrix::tests::.*: test$/ { count += 1 } END { print count + 0 }')" -eq 14

prior_failures.error: Missing variants and linked-primary parent directories before creating baseline symlinks; freeze/core preconditions then rejected the uninitialized configuration. No build or test ran.
prior_failures.disposition: Created required empty parent directories; rerun initialization and dependent stages with checked sequencing. Preserved the empty Core directory created by the first rejected attempt as core-focused-uninitialized before retry.

prior_failures.error: Compiler build wrote mech_gpu.json but linked-build expects the identical host.json alias. No emission, linking or measurements ran.
prior_failures.disposition: Copied the manifest-verified regular receipt to host.json; compiler binary and flags unchanged. Future build helper writes both names. Preserved the empty after directory from the first rejected setup as after-uninitialized; retry guard initially rejected that existing directory before execution.

prior_failures.classification: inherited unsupported native operation in an added fixture
prior_failures.command: numeric-lifetime-large/frame-before private-tree original 1 2 10; same with frame-after
prior_failures.error: Initial literal-array fixture rejects at NodeId(2); replacing it with an input array still rejects at NodeId(1) in both parent and candidate. NativeScalarOp has U32Add but no U16Add.
prior_failures.disposition: The initial initializer diagnosis was incorrect and is withdrawn. Only widening U16 arithmetic to U64 and checking the cast back makes the real-size witness pass, matching pinned source rebase-node at lines 76–78. Minimal U16-add source and both failures are retained. No native vocabulary expansion is required by the actual compressor; this inherited operation remains unsupported and separately assigned. Large diagnostic controls use the existing NoLimits mode; existing finite controls and benchmark settings are unchanged.

parent_candidate_scope: Both parent and candidate projection tests must pass. Parent controls use the exact retained R65 test binary with explicit historical build provenance; candidate tests and Core-dependent libraries are rebuilt. The six shape and twelve projection tests are freshly executed on both.

runtime_coverage.scope: Fresh full R66 runtime execution is required. Historical R63 batches are not counted. Projection12, shape6, Core367 and GPU CI selections are additional overlapping batches, not a sum of unique tests.

skipped_coverage.disposition: Existing runtime selection exclusion retained; unrelated complete knucleotide body is not requalified here.
Not awaited as requested. Local selected tests with their actual retained feature configurations and architecture checks are reported separately.
Not run; this optimization measures the complete pinned eight-byte level-12 call only.

scope: Observed inventory/execution counts only. Failed initial attempts retain their actual provenance and disposition; they are neither erased nor accepted as successful qualification.
